title: Leaving home
cue: "In the name of Allah, I rely on Allah…"
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
transliteration: Bismillaah, tawakkaltu 'alallaah, laa hawla walaa quwwata illaa billaah
translation: In the name of Allah. I rely on Allah. There is no power and no strength except through Allah.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sunan Abi Dawud, ed. Muhyi al-Din Abd al-Hamid, hadith 5095: https://shamela.ws/book/1726/6957

when: On going out of the house
usage.evidence: Whoever says this on leaving his house, it is said to him: you are guided, provided for and protected, and the devils move away from him (Abu Dawud 5095; al-Tirmidhi 3426).
